## History

Alec Davis was born a [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) before his wife converted him to Presbyterianism, ensuring he adhered to the faith throughout his life. Following his eventual death, his memory remained tied to his [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) origins. His widow later threatened to pull her support after leaving the local parish church.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P5](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0005), [v5 CHAPTER XV. MORE GOSSIP P0](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XV.
